reason: The NatWest case concretely illustrates the importance of robust transaction monitoring systems introduced in CH46-S01.
CH47-S01 introduces alert generation and review as a foundation; CH47-S06 later applies that foundation to the multi-level alert review procedure.
CH47-S01 defines thresholds in transaction monitoring; CH47-S04 later applies that concept to threshold setting as a key component of TM system tuning.
CH47-S03 introduces network analysis as a technology solution for detecting hidden connections; CH47-S14 later applies network analysis to relationship mapping and visualization during investigation.
The Deutsche Bank case study illustrates the critical tasks of concluding investigations and coordinating with law enforcement introduced in CH48-S01.
